title: eval-harness: per-prompt regression gating + CI metrics integration
author: Aisha Khan
body:
Context: We need tighter per-prompt quality controls in CI to catch regressions that are diluted by aggregate metrics. This change adds per-prompt gating configuration, an evaluator hook that computes per-prompt metrics during CI runs, and an exporter that surfaces those metrics as CI artifacts and to the metrics backend for dashboards.

What:
- Add per-prompt gating config (yaml) with thresholding semantics (delta, absolute).
- Hook into the eval-harness CI job to run per-prompt checks and produce a machine-readable report.
- Export per-prompt metrics (precision/recall/score) as CI artifacts and into our metrics pipeline for historical tracking.
- Add unit and integration tests covering gating logic and fallback behavior.
- Update docs and quickstart for configuring per-prompt gates.

Why:
Aggregate evaluation can hide prompt-specific regressions. Teams rely on prompt sets for critical flows (billing, compliance, helpdesk). Per-prompt gating lets us fail CI fast on regressions that matter to product owners while still reporting global metrics. Exporting metrics enables dashboards and long-term trend analysis.

Changes included (high level):
- Config: eval-harness/ci/gates/per_prompt_gates.yml (new)
- CI: ci/pipeline.yaml (add step run-eval-gates)
- Hook: eval-harness/ci/hooks/metrics_exporter.py (new)
- Eval logic: eval-harness/evaluator/per_prompt_gating.py (new)
- Tests: eval-harness/tests/test_per_prompt_gating.py (new), eval-harness/tests/fixtures/sample_prompt_set.json
- Docs: eval-harness/README.md (docs for gate configuration)

Checklist:
- [x] Per-prompt gate config format defined and validated
- [x] Evaluator computes per-prompt metrics and compares to gates
- [x] CI job emits artifacts and exposes pass/fail status based on gates
- [x] Unit and integration tests added
- [x] Docs updated with examples and roll-out notes

Testing & CI notes:
- Initial run hit a flaky integration test related to the Kafka-backed metric exporter. Re-ran the job after adding a backoff in the test harness; all CI checks pass.
- e2e-eval job includes a sample prompt set that demonstrates a failing prompt and a fixed baseline; this was used to validate gating semantics.

Rollout:
- Default behavior is gated off; teams opt-in by adding per_prompt_gates.yml to their prompt set folder.
- We will roll this out to core repos as an opt-in flag for two weeks before enabling for all new eval jobs.

Related: Linear ENG-3214, ENG-3330. Sup ticket SUP-1023 for a support customer request to gate billing-related prompts.

Notes for reviewers: pay attention to gating semantics (absolute vs delta thresholds) and the performance characteristics of metrics collection in the CI environment.
